'''Utilitech''' was a company based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. A subsidiary of [[GoCorp/Legends|GoCorp]], they produced the [[Metrocab Robo-Hack Landspeeder]]<ref name="EGTD" /> and [[WA-7 waitress droid/Legends|WA-7 Service droid]] together.
